newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-MIM picks AUSTA for power station sale.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-MIM picks AUSTA for power station sale.

text.p: AUSTA Electric, Queensland's electricity generating authority, said it has been selected as the preferred candidate to buy 80 per cent of MIM Holdings Ltd's Mica Creek power station.
The remaining 20 per cent of the 200 megawatt station, which supplies MIM's Mount Isa base metal operations, the town and surrounding areas, will be held by MIM in a joint venture, it said.
MIM's executive general manager at Mount Isa, Phil Wright said in a statement the sale was consistent with the company's policy of concentrating on its core assets.
The two companies hoped to reach an agreement before Christmas, he said.
MIM and AUSTA did not put a value on the stake but an analyst, who declined to be named, said it was worth about A$60 million.
